title: Normalized comparison of a descended action at one rational stage
statement: Let l be prime, Ω an algebraic closure of Padic l, X and Y schemes, and S a morphism between their unlifted common-stage systems [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, lem-general-algebraically-closed-coefficient-stages]. For each finite index E let O_E be a rational Operation on the small coefficient model Coefficient l Ω E [def-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction-data], H_E a functor between the corresponding raw rational constructible categories, and e_E : O_E.F ≅ H_E. Assume HEq(S.Φ E, O_E.F) at every E. For any E and any functor J from the Y pair category to an arbitrary category T, there exists q : inclusion_X(E) ⋙ S.functor ≅ H_E ⋙ inclusion_Y(E) such that, for every raw rational object A, there are raw rational objects B,B′ and an actual raw rational arrow r : B → B′ heterogeneously equal to e_E.hom.app A, with J.map(q.hom.app A) heterogeneously equal to J.map(inclusion_Y(E).map r). No property of J is assumed.

proof.text: The specified rational operation and the stage action have the same left functor by the supplied heterogeneous equality, after unfolding only their category aliases. Transport the given natural isomorphism e_E across that equality.

proof.text: Compose StageSystem.Morphism.ιCompFunctorIso E with inclusion_Y(E) applied to the transported e_E. The stage inclusion comparison has identity components. Eliminate the equality transport to prove heterogeneous equality of the component after applying any J. Regard the specified component as an actual arrow in the raw category and retain its heterogeneous equality and the map formula together.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteStageAction_normalizedComparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω]
    [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) (ULift.{u} Ω)]
    (X Y : Scheme.{u})
    (S : (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X).Morphism
      (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω Y))
    (O : ∀ E : Index l Ω, Operation l (ULift.{u} Ω) X Y
      (.rational ({ carrier := Coefficient.{u} l Ω E } : FieldStage.{u} l)))
    (H : ∀ E : Index l Ω, sfRationalConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) X ⥤
      sfRationalConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) Y)
    (e : ∀ E, (O E).F ≅ H E)
    (hf : ∀ E, HEq (S.Φ E) (O E).F) (E : Index l Ω)
    {T : Type*} [Category T]
    (J : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Pair l Ω Y ⥤ T) :
    ∃ q : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion (Y := X) E ⋙ S.functor ≅
        H E ⋙ GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion (Y := Y) E,
      ∀ A : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) X,
        ∃ (B B' : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) Y)
          (r : B ⟶ B'), HEq r ((e E).hom.app A) ∧
          HEq (J.map (q.hom.app A))
            (J.map ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion (Y := Y) E).map r))
